I answered Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from #north-team itself, which Marcus is in. On Aug 20, 2025, Dana posted there that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again during the morning shift. Thea was also the Quarrendon contact who joined the call during the Superior terminal incident. Marcus is a member of that incident channel too.
